sloka: वरुणो जनयामास सुषेणम् नाम वानरम् ।शरभम् जनयामास पर्जन्यः तु महाबलः ॥१-१७-१५॥
transliteration: varuṇo janayāmāsa suṣeṇam nāma vānaram ।śarabham janayāmāsa parjanyaḥ tu mahābalaḥ ॥1-17-15॥

translations.english: Vayu, the windgod, begot a son named Hanuman, mighty and graceful, having a body as hard as a diamond and speed equal to Garuda's.
